Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: On arrival in League City, Texas, I found two vehicles in the roadway at an intersection. Driver 1
reported that the vehicle was struck on the driver's side while Driver 2 was completing a left turn across their lane.
Driver 1 said they felt immediate pain in the lower back and were later checked by emergency medical personnel.
Driver 1 and a Passenger were both present in the vehicle when I arrived, and both confirmed their positions at the
time of impact. No bystanders were identified, and no photographs or prior reports of this collision were available to
me at the scene. Damage to both vehicles was consistent with the impact described by the drivers, with no obvious
signs of earlier damage to Driver 1's vehicle. The vehicle registration and insurance documents presented listed
Driver 1 as the named insured. Driver 2 was cited for failure to yeild the right of way. Both vehicles were towed from
the scene.
</page>
